heading.zh-Hant: 出身、一戰與戰間期
heading.en: Origins, the First World War and the inter-war years

body.zh-Hant: 奧金萊克（1884–1981）出身軍人家庭，從威靈頓公學畢業後進入桑德赫斯特軍校，1904年獲任第62旁遮普團軍官。一戰期間他在中東與美索不達米亞戰役中作戰，因此獲頒傑出服務勳章。戰間期他在奎達參謀學院任教官；1934年，因前一年在莫赫曼德地區指揮一個旅，獲頒巴斯勳章（CB）。
body.en: Claude Auchinleck (1884–1981) was born into a military family; after Wellington College he entered Sandhurst and in 1904 was commissioned into the 62nd Punjab Regiment. In the First World War he saw action in the Middle East and the Mesopotamia campaign and received the Distinguished Service Order. Between the wars he was an instructor at the Quetta Staff College, and in 1934 he was awarded the CB for leading a brigade in the Mohmand area the previous year.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰初期與印度總司令
heading.en: Early Second World War and Commander-in-Chief India

body.zh-Hant: 1939年大戰爆發時他已是少將，並指揮了1940年失利的納爾維克遠征部隊；其後在英國先任軍長，再任南方司令部司令。1940年11月晉升上將，隨即出任印度總司令；他迅速派兵平定1941年的伊拉克叛亂，贏得首相邱吉爾的讚許。至1941年7月5日，他卸下印度總司令職務，轉任中東總司令。
body.en: A major-general at the outbreak of war in 1939, he commanded the troops in the ill-fated Narvik expedition (1940), then served in England as a corps commander and as head of Southern Command. Promoted general in November 1940, he was appointed Commander-in-Chief India; his swift dispatch of troops against the 1941 uprising in Iraq won Churchill's approval. On 5 July 1941 he ceased to be Commander-in-Chief, India, and became Commander-in-Chief, Middle East.

heading.zh-Hant: 中東總司令與「十字軍」攻勢
heading.en: Middle East command and Operation Crusader

body.zh-Hant: 1941年7月他接替韋弗爾出任中東總司令。11月17日，第八集團軍在堪寧漢指揮下向西進攻昔蘭尼加，即「十字軍」行動；隆美爾於22日反攻，堪寧漢決定撤退，奧金萊克則親自接手，並於26日以里奇取代堪寧漢。攻勢繼續進行，至1942年1月6日肅清昔蘭尼加。
body.en: In July 1941 he succeeded Wavell as Commander-in-Chief, Middle East. On 17 November the Eighth Army under Alan Cunningham attacked westward into Cyrenaica (Operation Crusader); Rommel counter-attacked on 22 November and Cunningham decided to retreat, but Auchinleck took direct command and replaced him with Neil Ritchie on 26 November. The offensive continued, clearing Cyrenaica by 6 January 1942.

heading.zh-Hant: 加查拉敗退、第一次阿拉曼與去職
heading.en: Retreat, First Alamein and removal

body.zh-Hant: 1942年5月隆美爾先發制人，第八集團軍被德軍集中的裝甲兵力擊敗，托布魯克迅速陷落。6月25日奧金萊克親自接掌第八集團軍，在阿拉曼組織防禦，終於擋住隆美爾（第一次阿拉曼戰役）；但他無力協調反攻。8月邱吉爾飛抵開羅，改以亞歷山大任總司令、蒙哥馬利任集團軍司令；8月15日亞歷山大接掌中東總部。
body.en: Rommel struck first in May 1942 and the Eighth Army was defeated by concentrations of German armour; Tobruk fell rapidly. On 25 June Auchinleck took over direct command, organised a defence at El Alamein and finally stopped Rommel (First Battle of Alamein), but could not co-ordinate a counter-attack. In August Churchill flew to Cairo and substituted Alexander and Montgomery as Commander-in-Chief and army commander; Alexander took command of the Middle East Forces on 15 August.

heading.zh-Hant: 再任印度總司令與分治
heading.en: Second term in India and Partition

body.zh-Hant: 1943年6月他再度出任印度總司令，任內大力動員印度資源，尤其是對斯利姆第十四軍在緬甸的補給與增援。他不贊成戰後印度分治，仍協助印度軍隊準備分成印度與巴基斯坦兩軍；1946年6月1日晉升元帥，卻拒絕接受貴族爵位，1948年返回英國。
body.en: In June 1943 he accepted the post of Commander-in-Chief in India for a second time, mobilising India's resources for the war, notably the supply and reinforcement of Slim's Fourteenth Army in Burma. Though he disliked partition, he helped prepare the Indian Army for its division into the armies of Pakistan and India; promoted field marshal on 1 June 1946, he refused a peerage, and he returned to Britain in 1948.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與戰前經歷
heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 溫蓋特1903年2月26日生於印度奈尼塔爾，是英屬印度陸軍一名上校之子；他就讀查特豪斯公學與伍爾維奇皇家軍事學院，並在倫敦的東方研究學院進修。1929至1933年他在蘇丹國防軍服役；1936至1939年在巴勒斯坦執行特別任務，發展出對付襲擊輸油管的阿拉伯人的游擊戰術，並組織猶太小隊保衛猶太定居點。
body.en: Orde Wingate was born at Naini Tal, India, on 26 February 1903, the son of a British Indian Army colonel; he was educated at Charterhouse, trained at the Royal Military Academy at Woolwich and studied at the School of Oriental Studies in London. He served in the Sudan Defence Force from 1929 to 1933; on special duty in Palestine (1936–39) he developed guerrilla tactics against Arabs seeking to cut the Haifa pipeline and organised Jewish squads to defend Jewish settlements.

heading.zh-Hant: 衣索比亞解放戰役與基甸軍
heading.en: The Ethiopian campaign and Gideon Force

body.zh-Hant: 1940年6月10日墨索里尼對英法宣戰後，英國安排海爾·塞拉西皇帝飛往蘇丹，並任命當時為少校的溫蓋特為與流亡皇帝的聯絡官。1941年1月20日，他與皇帝越過衣索比亞邊界，隨行是他稱為「基甸軍」的一小支英國與衣索比亞部隊；他在隨後的解放戰役中擔任皇帝的總司令，這場戰役使戈贊擺脫義大利統治。1941年5月5日，他率領皇帝的軍隊進入亞的斯亞貝巴。
body.en: After Mussolini declared war on Britain and France on 10 June 1940, Britain arranged for Haile Selassie to fly to the Sudan and appointed Wingate, then a major, as liaison officer with the exiled emperor. On 20 January 1941 Wingate crossed the Ethiopian frontier with the emperor and a small group of British and Ethiopian troops he termed "Gideon Force"; he served as the emperor's commander-in-chief throughout the liberation campaign, which freed Gojam, and led the emperor's army into Addis Ababa on 5 May 1941.

heading.zh-Hant: 組建欽迪特與長布行動
heading.en: Raising the Chindits and Operation Longcloth

body.zh-Hant: 1942年2月24日溫蓋特晉升准將，受老長官韋弗爾之託，組織一支由英國人、印度人與緬甸人構成的游擊部隊，到緬甸對日作戰；他把這支部隊稱為「欽迪特」。1943年2月至4月，欽迪特展開第一次行動「長布行動」（Operation Longcloth），由溫蓋特統率，目標是破壞日軍交通線，並檢驗長程滲透戰術的成效。
body.en: On 24 February 1942 Wingate was promoted brigadier and entrusted by Wavell with organising a guerrilla force of British, Indians and Burmese to fight the Japanese in Burma, which he called the "Chindits". From February to April 1943 the Chindits mounted their first operation, Operation Longcloth, under Wingate, aiming to disrupt Japanese lines of communication and to test long-range penetration tactics.

heading.zh-Hant: 星期四行動與逝世
heading.en: Operation Thursday and death

body.zh-Hant: 1944年3月至8月的「星期四行動」中，欽迪特的規模擴大為六倍，約兩萬三千名受過完整訓練的士兵部署，支援中美軍向緬甸北部密支那推進。溫蓋特於3月24日探視一支欽迪特部隊時死於空難；邱吉爾在悼詞中稱他是「可能成為命運之人的天才」。
body.en: In Operation Thursday (March–August 1944) the Chindits, now six times larger, deployed around 23,000 fully trained men to support the Chinese and American advance on Myitkyina in northern Burma. Wingate was killed in a plane crash on 24 March while visiting a Chindit unit; Churchill called him "a man of genius who might well have also become a man of destiny".

heading.zh-Hant: 多佛與敦克爾克撤退
heading.en: Dover and the Dunkirk evacuation

body.zh-Hant: 1940年5月，拉姆齊以多佛海軍司令（flag officer commanding Dover）的身分，與海軍部、陸軍部一同擬定以「發電機」為代號的撤離計畫。撤退自5月26日進行至6月4日；英軍在法軍部分協助下共救出約三十三萬八千人，來源稱這是皇家海軍與拉姆齊高度組織能力的成果。
body.en: In May 1940 Ramsay, as flag officer commanding Dover, began with the Admiralty and War Office to improvise plans for an evacuation under the code name Dynamo. The evacuation ran from 26 May to 4 June 1940; the British, with some French assistance, rescued 338,000 men, which the source calls a feat of heroism and great organizational skill on the part of the Royal Navy and Ramsay.

heading.zh-Hant: 聯合指揮官委員會的海軍總司令
heading.en: Naval C-in-C of the Combined Commanders

body.zh-Hant: 1942年拉姆齊仍任多佛海軍中將，早在1942年初就加入聯合指揮官委員會，擔任海軍總司令，這是他額外兼任的職務。他在此職上擬定計畫並建立海軍編組，用於北非登陸；當時認為跨海峽作戰將從多佛發起，攻擊加萊海峽地區，這也是他獲選的原因。
body.en: In 1942 Ramsay was Vice-Admiral Dover and, from early 1942, was assigned extra duty as Naval Commander-in-Chief of the Combined Commanders. In that capacity he drew up the plans and set up the naval organization employed in the North African invasion; he was chosen because the cross-channel operation was then expected to be mounted from Dover against the Pas de Calais.

heading.zh-Hant: 調任地中海
heading.en: Transfer to the Mediterranean

body.zh-Hant: 1943年初拉姆齊調往地中海，起草西西里與義大利登陸的海軍計畫，並在坎寧安上將之下指揮參戰的皇家海軍部隊。1943年5月5日，他在英國聯合指揮官委員會的海軍總司令職位由另一位海軍上將查爾斯爵士接任。
body.en: Early in 1943 Ramsay was transferred to the Mediterranean, where he drafted the naval plans for the invasions of Sicily and Italy and, under Admiral Cunningham, commanded the Royal Navy forces engaged. On 5 May 1943 his place as Naval C-in-C of the British Combined Commanders was taken by Admiral Sir Charles.

heading.zh-Hant: 盟軍遠征軍海軍總司令與「海王星」
heading.en: Allied Naval Commander-in-Chief and Operation Neptune

body.zh-Hant: 1943年10月25日，拉姆齊獲任為盟軍遠征軍海軍總司令（ANCXF），其唯一職責是在最高統帥之下，指揮分配給「海王星」（即「霸王」行動突擊階段）的英、美與盟軍海軍部隊。1944年6月1日12時，他接掌「海王星」部隊的作戰指揮權，並總管海峽內的行動。他在報告中總結：就海軍觀點而言，儘管天候不佳，計畫在每一項主要方面都照寫的執行，戰術奇襲也已達成。
body.en: Ramsay was appointed Allied Naval Commander-in-Chief (ANCXF) on 25 October 1943; his only function was to exercise operational command, under the Supreme Commander, of the British, U.S. and Allied naval forces assigned to NEPTUNE, the assault phase of OVERLORD. At 1200 on 1 June 1944 he assumed operational command of NEPTUNE forces and general control of operations in the Channel. In his report he summarised that, from the naval point of view, the plan was carried out as written in every main essential despite the weather, and that tactical surprise was achieved.

heading.en: Origins, air force and airline

body.zh-Hant: 班尼特1910年9月14日生於昆士蘭的圖文巴，1930年入伍澳洲皇家空軍，翌年轉入英國皇家空軍第29中隊。他完成水上飛機課程後被派到彭布羅克碼頭的第210中隊，1933年成為水上飛機教官；1935年他認為和平時期空軍升遷有限而辭職，1936年1月在英國加入新創的商業水上飛機航空公司帝國航空。
body.en: Don Bennett was born in Toowoomba, Queensland, on 14 September 1910; he enlisted in the RAAF in 1930 and transferred to No. 29 Squadron RAF the following year. After a flying boat course he was posted to 210 Squadron at Pembroke Dock and became a flying boat instructor in 1933; in 1935, seeing limited prospects in the peacetime air force, he resigned, and in January 1936 he joined the commercial seaplane airline Imperial Airways in England.

heading.zh-Hant: 大西洋渡運與第77、第10中隊
heading.en: Atlantic ferry and Nos. 77 and 10 Squadrons

body.zh-Hant: 1940年7月他成為大西洋渡運服務的飛行主管，並率領首批七架哈德遜機飛越大西洋。1941年9月25日他以代理中校身分回到皇家空軍，1941年12月出任轟炸機司令部第77中隊指揮官，1942年4月轉任第10中隊指揮官。他親自出擊許多任務，在一次攻擊提爾皮茨號戰艦的行動中於挪威上空被擊落，設法逃脫、取道瑞典返國，並因此獲頒傑出服務勳章。
body.en: In July 1940 he became flying superintendent of the Atlantic Ferry service and led the first flight of seven Hudsons across. On 25 September 1941 he returned to the RAF as an acting wing commander; in December 1941 he took command of Bomber Command's 77 Squadron and in April 1942 moved to command 10 Squadron. He flew many operations himself; shot down over Norway in an attack on the Tirpitz, he evaded capture, reached Sweden and was awarded the Distinguished Service Order.

body.zh-Hant: 1942年7月5日，班尼特獲任命指揮轟炸機司令部新成立的開路者部隊，其任務是為主力機組找出並標示目標。1943年1月他再度晉升，並受命指揮轟炸機司令部的第8開路者大隊。1943年7月2日他獲頒大英帝國司令勳章，1944年6月8日獲頒巴斯勳章（CB）。
body.en: On 5 July 1942 Bennett was given command of Bomber Command's new Pathfinder Force, whose job was to find and mark targets for the main force crews. In January 1943 he was promoted again and placed in command of Bomber Command's 8 Pathfinder Force Group. He was made CBE on 2 July 1943 and Companion of the Order of the Bath on 8 June 1944.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後與逝世
heading.en: After the war and death

body.zh-Hant: 班尼特是主張成立國際警察部隊以防止戰爭的人，並以自由黨黨員身分贏得國會議席，但最終對自己無法發揮影響力感到失望。戰後他也設計並製造了數款輕型飛機與汽車。他於1986年9月15日去世。
body.en: A keen advocate of an international police force to prevent war, Bennett won a seat in Parliament as a Liberal Party member, but was ultimately disappointed at his inability to exert influence. After the war he also designed and built several light aircraft and cars. He died on 15 September 1986.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、南非戰爭與一戰
heading.en: Origins, the South African War and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 艾恩賽德1880年5月6日生。他十九歲離開伍爾維奇後投入南非戰爭，獲通報嘉獎並升至參謀上尉，其後留在非洲，被調入情報機構。1914年8月，他以參謀上尉身分成為第一位踏上法國土地的英軍制服軍官；1915年獲頒傑出服務勳章，1918年3月至10月間指揮第99旅。
body.en: Ironside was born on 6 May 1880. He left Woolwich at nineteen and served in the South African War, was mentioned in despatches and reached the rank of staff captain, then stayed in Africa and was seconded to the Secret Service. In August 1914, as a staff captain, he was the first British officer in uniform to land in France; he received the DSO in 1915 and commanded the 99th Brigade in France from March to October 1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 阿爾漢格爾的盟軍指揮
heading.en: Command of the Allied force at Archangel

body.zh-Hant: 1918年11月，艾恩賽德被選為阿爾漢格爾盟軍的指揮官。他的部隊占據一塊與大不列顛同樣大的地區，成分混雜、紀律困難，他仍設法鞏固陣地並招募約兩萬五千名當地人，一度看似能與高爾察克會合。1919年夏盟國決定撤出，他以不斷的後衛作戰將部隊撤離，未造成重大損失；他本人於1919年9月27日離開阿爾漢格爾。
body.en: In November 1918 Ironside was chosen to command the Allied forces at Archangel. His force occupied an area as large as Great Britain and was of mixed character; he nevertheless consolidated his position and recruited some 25,000 local men, and at one moment it seemed the Archangel force might join up with Kolchak. By the summer of 1919 the Allied governments decided to withdraw, and by constant rear-guard action he embarked his force without serious losses; he himself left Archangel on 27 September 1919.

heading.zh-Hant: 伊斯米特、波斯與參謀學院
heading.en: Ismid, Persia and the Staff College

body.zh-Hant: 其後盟軍派兵占領伊斯米特半島，艾恩賽德受命指揮這支部隊，於1920年夏末被召回。之後他接任伊拉克的一個師指揮官，並指揮北波斯部隊；返回英國後出任坎伯利參謀學院院長。其後他曾回印度任軍需總監，並出任英國東部司令部司令。
body.en: An Allied force was then sent to occupy the Ismid Peninsula, and Ironside was appointed to command it until he was recalled in the late summer of 1920. He then took over a divisional command in Iraq and commanded the North Persian Force; back home he became Commandant of the Staff College at Camberley, later returned to India as Quartermaster General and was appointed G.O.C. Eastern Command in England.

heading.zh-Hant: 直布羅陀、帝國總參謀長與本土部隊
heading.en: Gibraltar, CIGS and Home Forces

body.zh-Hant: 1938年11月，艾恩賽德被派任直布羅陀總督兼總司令，投入大量精力使該地具備現代戰爭下的防禦能力。大戰爆發時他被召回擔任帝國總參謀長；德軍於5月26日抵達加萊時，他改任本土部隊總司令。他於1941年1月29日受封艾恩賽德男爵。
body.en: In November 1938 Ironside was sent out as Governor and Commander in Chief of Gibraltar and flung his energy into making it capable of defence in modern warfare. When war came he was recalled to be Chief of the Imperial General Staff; as the Germans reached Calais on 26 May he was made Commander in Chief of the home forces. He became Baron Ironside on 29 January 1941.
